title: Window Engagement Space Submit
description: Spacebar inside a window: empty command repeats last engagement; non-empty command submits on Space when focus is outside the engagement field (type-to-engage flow).
summary: Window-level Space routing now matches in-field Engagement behavior: empty draft calls onRepeatLast (repeat last finalized engagement); non-empty draft calls onSubmit (start engagement). Previously routeWindowEngagementSpace only handled the empty repeat path, so type-to-engage (printable keys routed into the window, then Space) did not submit. Added tests for routeWindowEngagementSpace submit and Engagement Space with draft. All 118 @semio-tech/ui-react tests pass.
